items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: can go from Don Cherry to Art Farmer. He covers it all.

ctx.x: Randy is, to me, a very underrated great jazz player.

Yeah, I think he’s number one – he’s my favorite trumpet player of all time, period, nobody more creative, and can go from Don Cherry to Art Farmer. He covers it all. He knows more than anybody. He’s just – I could talk about career moves, but I think he spread himself too thin, maybe. Also, his brother was so popular. I don’t know what happened. I think Randy made some moves that I wouldn’t agree with, that’s all, and diluted his essence of who he was from a standpoint of the industry, the business. He was just…
